clips.title: The story
paras: Garments of the Light is an early rite of passage for fledgling dwarven priests in Dun Morogh. Directed by Priest Trainer Maxan Anvol in Kharanos, the initiate is tasked with aiding a wounded mountaineer just outside town to earn their vestments.

Traditionally, acolytes of the Holy Light undergo formal trials to prove they are worthy of wearing church vestments. In Kharanos, however, priest trainer Maxan Anvol favors practical results over ceremony. With local patrols hard-pressed against troggs and wild beasts, theoretical exams take a back seat when actual defenders lie bleeding in the snow.

To earn their robes, young priests are sent just south of town to locate Mountaineer Dolf, who was wounded in the line of duty. By mending Dolf's injuries with restorative prayers and bolstering his constitution with Power Word: Fortitude, the initiate proves that their devotion translates directly into survival for the defenders of Ironforge.

Upon aiding the mountaineer, Maxan Anvol presents the acolyte with their formal garments. Beyond providing warm insulation against Dun Morogh's chill, these robes serve as a visual badge of office, signaling to wounded wanderers and local guards alike that a servant of the Light is present to offer aid.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's usually about this time that one of your power is tested to see if they're worthy of wearing robes denoting their place in the church. But to be honest, I got more pressing matters to look into. Citizen of Kharanos' just came in here and told me 'bout a hurt mountaineer just outside town to the south--name's Dolf.
You heal Dolf and give him Fortitude, and I'll consider you done with proving yourself. How's that sound?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Have you found Dolf yet, friend?

You've probably already learned this, but our ability to heal is very useful. Not only are we able to take care of the wounded, but we're vital to the survival of all those would-be heroes out there trying to make a name for themselves. With Fortitude to increase the amount of blows we can take, and our healing magic to keep them alive, there's nothing we can't overcome!

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend With one more healthy guard out there to help the town, we'll be that much safer. I'm glad to see you're already learning to use your abilities wisely. If you feel you are ready for more training at any time, please come back to me. But for now, take this robe. It will let others know that you are one of our order. If you don't want to wear it, that's fine. Later there will be more tests and this robe isn't necessary for those.
